title: Governed SHELL-CREW bindings entry
description: Closed, total schema for a state/crew-profile-bindings.json entry keyed by a governed profile name (model-economy S3). harness, model, and backups are required and fully typed; effort, when present, is enum-constrained (an empty-string effort is rejected); backups items are typed objects with uniqueItems. model must be a string, proven BEFORE any cross-surface comparison. Whether effort is present is proven per tier by the validator's cross-check.
